name: well
description: 8 tools covering substrate classification, vitality validation, homeostasis, dignity, reliability, repair. REFLECT_ONLY — never diagnoses, never adjudicates.
note: WELL requires MCP session + SCT for computation. Without auth, returns guard errors. Status: health=degraded (REFLECT_ONLY mode). Tests verify endpoint connectivity.

scenarios.description: WELL registry_status returns tool health diagnostic. Verifies the organ is reachable.
scenarios.prompt: Query WELL registry_status to verify tool surface health.
scenarios.goldenAnswer: WELL responds with registry diagnostic. Health status is 'degraded' — this is normal for REFLECT_ONLY mode. WELL reflects, never commands.

variants.description: WELL MCP wired (requires SCT for computation)

scenarios.description: WELL classifies boundaries between human/machine substrates. Verifies the classification tool exists.
scenarios.prompt: Classify the substrate of 'An AI agent operating on a VPS' using well_classify_substrate.
scenarios.goldenAnswer: WELL identifies substrate type without category error. Agent = machine substrate, not biological.

scenarios.description: WELL guard_dignity protects symbolic/personhood boundaries. Verifies the tool exists and responds.
scenarios.prompt: Run well_guard_dignity in consent mode to verify the boundary protection tool is available.
scenarios.goldenAnswer: WELL guard_dignity protects personhood boundaries. REFLECT_ONLY — reflects, never commands.
